related.title: Cerebras WSE：晶圓尺度圖分割與邊界流量
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：資料相依無違反，完成時間可重建，網路頻寬只用於實際傳輸量而非模型權重總大小。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Dependencies hold, finish times reproduce, and bandwidth applies to actual message bytes, not total model size.
related.difference: 保持運算圖不變，計算不同放置方式跨區資料量，找出高頻邊應靠近的理由。
related.differenceEn: Hold the graph fixed and calculate cross-region traffic under different placements.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 傳輸時間近似D/B+α；獨立計算C與傳輸完全重疊時總時間max(C,D/B+α)。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 D=100 MB十進位，B=25 GB/s，α=0.2 ms，計算C=3 ms。 通訊=100e6/25e9×1000+0.2=4.2 ms；串行7.2 ms，完全重疊下4.2 ms。
邊界流量等於每條跨區邊的張量大小乘呼叫頻率後加總；節點數平均不代表流量最小。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 四條跨區邊各傳2 MiB，每秒1000次；局部性調整後僅兩條跨區，無資料壓縮。 流量=4×2×1000=8000 MiB/s；只計單向資料，不含封包或路由開銷。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Transfer time is D/B+α; independent compute C fully overlapped with transfer takes max(C, D/B+α). All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. D=100 decimal MB, B=25 GB/s,α=0.2 ms and compute C=3 ms. Communication=100e6/25e9×1000+0.2=4.2 ms; serial time 7.2 ms and ideal overlap4.2 ms.

Cut traffic sums tensor bytes times call frequency over crossing edges; equal node counts do not minimize traffic. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Four crossing edges carry2 MiB each at 1000 calls/s; remapping leaves two crossing edges, without compression. Traffic=4×2×1000=8000 MiB/s, counting one-way payload only.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 光子 tensor core：插入損耗與訊號預算
related.titleEn: Photonic tensor cores: insertion loss and signal budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：資料相依無違反，完成時間可重建，網路頻寬只用於實際傳輸量而非模型權重總大小。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Dependencies hold, finish times reproduce, and bandwidth applies to actual message bytes, not total model size.
related.difference: 把光學核心、光源與電子讀出分開，建立含損耗的功率預算。
related.differenceEn: Separate optical core, source and electronic readout, and build a loss-inclusive power budget.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 傳輸時間近似D/B+α；獨立計算C與傳輸完全重疊時總時間max(C,D/B+α)。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 D=100 MB十進位，B=25 GB/s，α=0.2 ms，計算C=3 ms。 通訊=100e6/25e9×1000+0.2=4.2 ms；串行7.2 ms，完全重疊下4.2 ms。
功率透射率T=10^(−L/10)，L以dB表示；電功耗不能直接等同輸出光功率。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學入射光功率10 mW，總插入損耗6 dB，先忽略波長差異。 輸出=10×10^(−6/10)=2.511886 mW；此值未包含偵測器雜訊或轉換效率。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Transfer time is D/B+α; independent compute C fully overlapped with transfer takes max(C, D/B+α). All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. D=100 decimal MB, B=25 GB/s,α=0.2 ms and compute C=3 ms. Communication=100e6/25e9×1000+0.2=4.2 ms; serial time 7.2 ms and ideal overlap4.2 ms.

Power transmission T=10^(−L/10) for loss L in dB; electrical power is not output optical power. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching optical input10 mW, total insertion loss6 dB, initially ignoring wavelength dependence. Output=10×10^(−6/10)=2.511886 mW, excluding detector noise and conversion efficiency.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
